description: This file defines a class Smarty_Internal_Method_AppendByRef that provides a method to append values to template variables by reference within the Smarty templating engine. It includes a method appendByRef() which modifies template data, allowing merging or appending, and handles scope updates.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Method_AppendByRef
classes.description: Class providing a method to append values to Smarty template variables by reference, supporting merging and scope updates.

methods.name: appendByRef
methods.description: Appends values to a template variable by reference, with optional merging; updates scope if necessary.
